description:
List, create, update, delete, or test webhook endpoints. Use only when the user is explicitly managing webhook configuration. Backwork delivers one event type, compliance.acknowledged; policy-change webhooks are not sent.

Takes codes, payers, plan types and states only. Never send patient names, dates of birth, member IDs or other patient identifiers.

Supports optional response_format: 'markdown' (default) for readable text or 'json' for the returned structuredContent object.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. compliance.acknowledged is the only event delivered; '*' subscribes to every event.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for readable text or 'json' for machine-readable structuredContent.

name: backwork_webhook_management

authorities.description: Issuing authorities, for example "CMS" or a payer name.

retrieved_at.description: Oldest retrieval time among the cited sources: every source was fetched at or after this time.

source_urls.description: Distinct source document URLs to cite.
